anchors.anchor: How does Lucy McKenzie find the Agency’s customer service?
“Oh,” the Chief People Officer says, sounding surprised.
“And to mine,” the Head of Inhuman Resources chimes in.
Lucy’s presence fades from my mind like mist on the wind.
I’m in poor enough standing as it is.
I saw it in her glassy, unfocused eyes.
I can’t remember the last time I was this confused.
